summary: Cross-session agent visibility + cooperative stop shipped. daemon.js: /agent/start now records task/session/workspace on the agent. GET /agents lists every agent {agent_id,type,state,task,session,workspace,startedAt,endedAt,stop_requested}. POST /agent/stop sets advisory overlay.stop_requested[agentId] (resolves agent by agent_id, or by task_key via assignee/agent.task; 404 if neither resolves) + atomic save. GET /agent/stop-requested?agent_id= is the worker's poll endpoint. Cooperative-cancel convention: NO cross-process kill — worker polls and self-terminates. overlay.js EMPTY() gained stop_requested:{} (load() spread back-fills). mcp-core.js: list_agents + request_agent_stop(agent_id|task_key) tools. smoke.sh: 5 assertions. Reused task/14 flag machinery pattern. Smoke 28/28.
